tools.name: get_clock_preferences
tools.description: Reads all keys from the resolved SharedPreferences XML file, returning display_clock_seconds, home_time_zone, and other discovered build-dependent keys.

success.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.

display_clock_seconds.description: Whether to display seconds on the clock face.

home_time_zone.description: The home time zone identifier if initialized.

other_preferences.description: Other discovered build-dependent clock style, alarm, timer, week-start, and screen-saver keys.

tools.name: set_clock_preference
tools.description: Writes the specified key-value pair into the SharedPreferences XML, preserving unknown keys and structural XML integrity.

value.description: The value to set. For boolean keys like 'display_clock_seconds', use 'true' or 'false'.

success.description: Indicates if the preference was successfully updated.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.
